title: Getting started with Solo Raiding (IP)
body:
Figure out how to start solo raiding can be overwhelming and with various resources saying different things it can be confusing to know where to get started. If you found yourself here interested in learning about solo raiding; you are at the right place.

In this article I'll walk you through the challenges every new solo raider encounters know and directions to tackle those challenges

#1: What is a solo raid? How do I solo a raid?

Solo Raids are any tier of raids where a Pokemon raid boss can be defeated by a single player. Tier 1 (Pink) and Tier 3 (yellow) for example are known in the widespread community to be soloable raids. Tier 4 (Mega) and Tier 5 (Legendary), which this archive logs, are in an increasing tier of raid pool where the bosses are soloable. Fun Fact:

  1. 100% of Tier 4 (mega) raids are soloable and have been recorded prior to Mega Ascension event.
  2. 100% of Future tier 4 raids (legends Z-A) are also known to be soloable.
  3. Nearly 80% of Legendary Tier 5 bosses are soloable
  4. and about 70% of the vods accumulated for these Tier 5 raids have been accumulated.


The challenge for a solo is simple: Defeat the raid boss within the allocated time.
